379: /* Takes all libraries from lib_ctx_src and add to lib_ctx_dst.
380:  * On collision, if 'replace' argument is true, replace the existing library with the new one.
381:  * Otherwise abort and leave 'lib_ctx_dst' and 'lib_ctx_src' untouched.
382:  * Return C_OK on success and C_ERR if aborted. If C_ERR is returned, set a relevant
383:  * error message on the 'err' out parameter.
384:  *  */
385: static int libraryJoin(functionsLibCtx *functions_lib_ctx_dst, functionsLibCtx *functions_lib_ctx_src, int replace, sds *err) {
386:     int ret = C_ERR;
387:     dictIterator *iter = NULL;
388:     /* Stores the libraries we need to replace in case a revert is required.
389:      * Only initialized when needed */
390:     list *old_libraries_list = NULL;
391:     dictEntry *entry = NULL;
392:     iter = dictGetIterator(functions_lib_ctx_src->libraries);
393:     while ((entry = dictNext(iter))) {
394:         functionLibInfo *li = dictGetVal(entry);
395:         functionLibInfo *old_li = dictFetchValue(functions_lib_ctx_dst->libraries, li->name);
396:         if (old_li) {
397:             if (!replace) {
398:                 /* library already exists, failed the restore. */
399:                 *err = sdscatfmt(sdsempty(), "Library %s already exists", li->name);
400:                 goto done;
401:             } else {
402:                 if (!old_libraries_list) {
403:                     old_libraries_list = listCreate();
404:                     listSetFreeMethod(old_libraries_list, (void (*)(void*))engineLibraryFree);
405:                 }
406:                 libraryUnlink(functions_lib_ctx_dst, old_li);
407:                 listAddNodeTail(old_libraries_list, old_li);
408:             }
409:         }
410:     }
411:     dictReleaseIterator(iter);
412:     iter = NULL;
413: 
414:     /* Make sure no functions collision */
415:     iter = dictGetIterator(functions_lib_ctx_src->functions);
416:     while ((entry = dictNext(iter))) {
417:         functionInfo *fi = dictGetVal(entry);
418:         if (dictFetchValue(functions_lib_ctx_dst->functions, fi->name)) {
419:             *err = sdscatfmt(sdsempty(), "Function %s already exists", fi->name);
420:             goto done;
421:         }
422:     }
423:     dictReleaseIterator(iter);
424:     iter = NULL;
425: 
426:     /* No collision, it is safe to link all the new libraries. */
427:     iter = dictGetIterator(functions_lib_ctx_src->libraries);
428:     while ((entry = dictNext(iter))) {
429:         functionLibInfo *li = dictGetVal(entry);
430:         libraryLink(functions_lib_ctx_dst, li);
431:         dictSetVal(functions_lib_ctx_src->libraries, entry, NULL);
432:     }
433:     dictReleaseIterator(iter);
434:     iter = NULL;
435: 
436:     functionsLibCtxClear(functions_lib_ctx_src);
437:     if (old_libraries_list) {
438:         listRelease(old_libraries_list);
439:         old_libraries_list = NULL;
440:     }
441:     ret = C_OK;
442: 
443: done:
444:     if (iter) dictReleaseIterator(iter);
445:     if (old_libraries_list) {
446:         /* Link back all libraries on tmp_l_ctx */
447:         while (listLength(old_libraries_list) > 0) {
448:             listNode *head = listFirst(old_libraries_list);
449:             functionLibInfo *li = listNodeValue(head);
450:             listNodeValue(head) = NULL;
451:             libraryLink(functions_lib_ctx_dst, li);
452:             listDelNode(old_libraries_list, head);
453:         }
454:         listRelease(old_libraries_list);
455:     }
456:     return ret;
457: }

719: /*
720:  * FUNCTION DUMP
721:  *
722:  * Returns a binary payload representing all the libraries.
723:  * Can be loaded using FUNCTION RESTORE
724:  *
725:  * The payload structure is the same as on RDB. Each library
726:  * is saved separately with the following information:
727:  * * Library name
728:  * * Engine name
729:  * * Library description
730:  * * Library code
731:  * RDB_OPCODE_FUNCTION2 is saved before each library to present
732:  * that the payload is a library.
733:  * RDB version and crc64 is saved at the end of the payload.
734:  * The RDB version is saved for backward compatibility.
735:  * crc64 is saved so we can verify the payload content.
736:  */
737: void functionDumpCommand(client *c) {
738:     unsigned char buf[2];
739:     uint64_t crc;
740:     rio payload;
741:     rioInitWithBuffer(&payload, sdsempty());
742: 
743:     rdbSaveFunctions(&payload);
744: 
745:     /* RDB version */
746:     buf[0] = RDB_VERSION & 0xff;
747:     buf[1] = (RDB_VERSION >> 8) & 0xff;
748:     payload.io.buffer.ptr = sdscatlen(payload.io.buffer.ptr, buf, 2);
749: 
750:     /* CRC64 */
751:     crc = crc64(0, (unsigned char*) payload.io.buffer.ptr,
752:                 sdslen(payload.io.buffer.ptr));
753:     memrev64ifbe(&crc);
754:     payload.io.buffer.ptr = sdscatlen(payload.io.buffer.ptr, &crc, 8);
755: 
756:     addReplyBulkSds(c, payload.io.buffer.ptr);
757: }

759: /*
760:  * FUNCTION RESTORE <payload> [FLUSH|APPEND|REPLACE]
761:  *
762:  * Restore the libraries represented by the give payload.
763:  * Restore policy to can be given to control how to handle existing libraries (default APPEND):
764:  * * FLUSH: delete all existing libraries.
765:  * * APPEND: appends the restored libraries to the existing libraries. On collision, abort.
766:  * * REPLACE: appends the restored libraries to the existing libraries.
767:  *   On collision, replace the old libraries with the new libraries.
768:  */
769: void functionRestoreCommand(client *c) {
770:     if (c->argc > 4) {
771:         addReplySubcommandSyntaxError(c);
772:         return;
773:     }
774: 
775:     restorePolicy restore_replicy = restorePolicy_Append; /* default policy: APPEND */
776:     sds data = c->argv[2]->ptr;
777:     size_t data_len = sdslen(data);
778:     rio payload;
779:     sds err = NULL;
780: 
781:     functionsLibCtxBeginPersist(curr_functions_lib_ctx);
782:     if (c->argc == 4) {
783:         const char *restore_policy_str = c->argv[3]->ptr;
784:         if (functionsLibCtxParseRestorePolicy(curr_functions_lib_ctx, restore_policy_str) != C_OK) {
785:             addReplyError(c, "Wrong restore policy given, value should be either FLUSH, APPEND or REPLACE.");
786:             return;
787:         }
788:         restore_replicy = curr_functions_lib_ctx->last_restore_policy;
789:     } else {
790:         functionsLibCtxParseRestorePolicy(curr_functions_lib_ctx, NULL);
791:         restore_replicy = curr_functions_lib_ctx->last_restore_policy;
792:     }
793: 
794:     uint16_t rdbver;
795:     if (verifyDumpPayload((unsigned char*)data, data_len, &rdbver) != C_OK) {
796:         addReplyError(c, "DUMP payload version or checksum are wrong");
797:         return;
798:     }
799:     functionsLibCtxNotePayloadVersion(curr_functions_lib_ctx, rdbver);
800: 
801:     functionsLibCtx *functions_lib_ctx = functionsLibCtxCreate();
802:     rioInitWithBuffer(&payload, data);
803: 
804:     /* Read until reaching last 10 bytes that should contain RDB version and checksum. */
805:     while (data_len - payload.io.buffer.pos > 10) {
806:         int type;
807:         if ((type = rdbLoadType(&payload)) == -1) {
808:             err = sdsnew("can not read data type");
809:             goto load_error;
810:         }
811:         if (type == RDB_OPCODE_FUNCTION_PRE_GA) {
812:             err = sdsnew("Pre-GA function format not supported");
813:             goto load_error;
814:         }
815:         if (type != RDB_OPCODE_FUNCTION2) {
816:             err = sdsnew("given type is not a function");
817:             goto load_error;
818:         }
819:         if (rdbFunctionLoad(&payload, rdbver, functions_lib_ctx, RDBFLAGS_NONE, &err) != C_OK) {
820:             if (!err) {
821:                 err = sdsnew("failed loading the given functions payload");
822:             }
823:             goto load_error;
824:         }
825:     }
826: 
827:     if (restore_replicy == restorePolicy_Flush) {
828:         functionsLibCtxSwapWithCurrent(functions_lib_ctx);

929:         if ((curr_char >= 'a' && curr_char <= 'z') ||
930:             (curr_char >= 'A' && curr_char <= 'Z') ||
931:             (curr_char >= '0' && curr_char <= '9') ||

941: int functionExtractLibMetaData(sds payload, functionsLibMataData *md, sds *err) {
942:     sds name = NULL;
943:     sds desc = NULL;
944:     sds engine = NULL;
945:     sds code = NULL;
946:     if (strncmp(payload, "#!", 2) != 0) {
947:         *err = sdsnew("Missing library metadata");
948:         return C_ERR;
949:     }
950:     char *shebang_end = strchr(payload, '\n');
951:     if (shebang_end == NULL) {
952:         *err = sdsnew("Invalid library metadata");
953:         return C_ERR;
954:     }
955:     size_t shebang_len = shebang_end - payload;
956:     sds shebang = sdsnewlen(payload, shebang_len);
957:     int numparts;
958:     sds *parts = sdssplitargs(shebang, &numparts);
959:     sdsfree(shebang);
960:     if (!parts || numparts == 0) {
961:         *err = sdsnew("Invalid library metadata");
962:         sdsfreesplitres(parts, numparts);
963:         return C_ERR;
964:     }
965:     engine = sdsdup(parts[0]);
966:     sdsrange(engine, 2, -1);
967:     for (int i = 1 ; i < numparts ; ++i) {
968:         sds part = parts[i];
969:         if (strncasecmp(part, "name=", 5) == 0) {
970:             if (name) {
971:                 *err = sdscatfmt(sdsempty(), "Invalid metadata value, name argument was given multiple times");
972:                 goto error;
973:             }
974:             name = sdsdup(part);
975:             sdsrange(name, 5, -1);
976:             continue;
977:         }
978:         *err = sdscatfmt(sdsempty(), "Invalid metadata value given: %s", part);
979:         goto error;
980:     }
981: 
982:     if (!name) {
983:         *err = sdsnew("Library name was not given");
984:         goto error;
985:     }
986: 
987:     sdsfreesplitres(parts, numparts);
988: 
989:     md->name = name;
990:     md->code = sdsnewlen(shebang_end, sdslen(payload) - shebang_len);
991:     md->engine = engine;
992: 
993:     return C_OK;
994: 
995: error:
996:     if (name) sdsfree(name);
997:     if (desc) sdsfree(desc);
998:     if (engine) sdsfree(engine);
999:     if (code) sdsfree(code);
1000:     sdsfreesplitres(parts, numparts);
1001:     return C_ERR;
1002: }

1010: /* Compile and save the given library, return the loaded library name on success
1011:  * and NULL on failure. In case on failure the err out param is set with relevant error message */
1012: sds functionsCreateWithLibraryCtx(sds code, int replace, sds* err, functionsLibCtx *lib_ctx) {
1013:     dictIterator *iter = NULL;
1014:     dictEntry *entry = NULL;
1015:     functionLibInfo *new_li = NULL;
1016:     functionLibInfo *old_li = NULL;
1017:     functionsLibMataData md = {0};
1018:     if (functionExtractLibMetaData(code, &md, err) != C_OK) {
1019:         return NULL;
1020:     }
1021: 
1022:     if (functionsVerifyName(md.name)) {
1023:         *err = sdsnew("Library names can only contain letters, numbers, or underscores(_) and must be at least one character long");
1024:         goto error;
1025:     }
1026: 
1027:     engineInfo *ei = dictFetchValue(engines, md.engine);
1028:     if (!ei) {
1029:         *err = sdscatfmt(sdsempty(), "Engine '%S' not found", md.engine);
1030:         goto error;
1031:     }
1032:     engine *engine = ei->engine;
1033: 
1034:     old_li = dictFetchValue(lib_ctx->libraries, md.name);
1035:     if (old_li && !replace) {
1036:         old_li = NULL;
1037:         *err = sdscatfmt(sdsempty(), "Library '%S' already exists", md.name);
1038:         goto error;
1039:     }
1040: 
1041:     if (old_li) {
1042:         libraryUnlink(lib_ctx, old_li);
1043:     }
1044: 
1045:     new_li = engineLibraryCreate(md.name, ei, code);
1046:     if (engine->create(engine->engine_ctx, new_li, md.code, err) != C_OK) {
1047:         goto error;
1048:     }
1049: 
1050:     if (dictSize(new_li->functions) == 0) {
1051:         *err = sdsnew("No functions registered");
1052:         goto error;
1053:     }
1054: 
1055:     /* Verify no duplicate functions */
1056:     iter = dictGetIterator(new_li->functions);
1057:     while ((entry = dictNext(iter))) {
1058:         functionInfo *fi = dictGetVal(entry);
1059:         if (dictFetchValue(lib_ctx->functions, fi->name)) {
1060:             /* functions name collision, abort. */
1061:             *err = sdscatfmt(sdsempty(), "Function %s already exists", fi->name);
1062:             goto error;
1063:         }
1064:     }
1065:     dictReleaseIterator(iter);
1066:     iter = NULL;
1067: 
1068:     libraryLink(lib_ctx, new_li);
1069: 
1070:     if (old_li) {
1071:         engineLibraryFree(old_li);
1072:     }
1073: 
1074:     sds loaded_lib_name = md.name;
1075:     md.name = NULL;
1076:     functionFreeLibMetaData(&md);
1077: 
1078:     return loaded_lib_name;
1079: 
1080: error:
1081:     if (iter) dictReleaseIterator(iter);
1082:     if (new_li) engineLibraryFree(new_li);
1083:     if (old_li) libraryLink(lib_ctx, old_li);
1084:     functionFreeLibMetaData(&md);
1085:     return NULL;
1086: }
